treatment.logline: A driver carries private concern through a rain-lit city until an employer's instruction redirects the van; a glance at a red wrist thread leaves his response unexplained.

arc.beat: Work routine and a personal keepsake share the cab.
Recorded concern reaches him before a separate live instruction.
The wrist glance precedes a deliberate change of course.

treatment.approach: Tight handheld observational coverage from within the cab, with small vehicle-borne vibration rather than agitation. The 90-second source bin gives editorially necessary driving masters, listening singles and sustained landing reactions around a short text. Use each audio event once; coverage is not an instruction to repeat dialogue. No chase, no inference that the two contacts explain one another.

treatment.geography: Right-hand-drive cash van. Dinu remains seated centre of driver-oriented frames, facing the road. Left wrist carries the red thread; both hands begin on the wheel. Dashboard photograph sits left of the instrument cluster. Cameras remain within the cab, on the passenger side or directly behind the driver, preserving the roadward axis. No visible phone or invented interface is needed.
treatment.key_image: Dinu's eyes lower toward the red thread above the wheel, then return to the wet road before he steers.
advice: Keep the message audibly recorded and the later instruction audibly live; neither remote person has a visible body.
Let the faded photograph register as a printed keepsake, not an apparition or a flashback.
Hold the listening face after each audio event; never imply that the employer knows the content of the message.
Coverage supplies duration and editorial breathing room, not additional plot.

moments.cut_uses: Rear-cab master establishes road and driver, passenger-side single finds his concentration, tighter forward-road master sustains the journey without a new event.

moments.what: A faded dashboard photograph connects the present cab to a shared village memory.
moments.cut_uses: Dashboard detail shows a faded printed pair at a bus stop; driver-and-dashboard frame restores the keepsake's place beside him. Printed faces remain indistinct.

moments.what: Recorded audio begins and Dinu absorbs L3, then remains with its aftermath.
moments.feeling: Concern settling behind a working driver's restraint.
moments.cut_uses: Passenger-side listening single carries the complete L3; rear three-quarter listening master provides contiguous audio-safe coverage; closer reaction holds the landing with lips closed. Use L3 only once.

moments.what: An incoming connection interrupts the personal interval.
moments.cut_uses: Driver-and-dashboard master locates the incoming tone; tighter reaction catches his attention returning to immediate duty without an invented handset gesture.

moments.what: Dinu receives the complete L5 instruction.
moments.cut_uses: Listening single carries L5; rear three-quarter master supplies the same whole instruction under steady driving. Select audio once, allowing an unhurried reaction.

moments.what: Dinu looks down at his wrist thread, returns his eyes to the road and turns toward the industrial area.
moments.cut_uses: Tight driver-and-wheel frame contains the whole glance-before-turn action; wider rear master and passenger-side single cover the same action for a clean glance-to-steering edit, not three repeated turns.

editor_notes: The 92-second bin is raw source, not a locked 92-second edit. Use the driving masters for geography, singles for interior attention, the required photograph detail to register the keepsake, and reactions for landing space.

Although c13 was generated after the line angles, place its b2 playback onset before c06 or c07 for b3. Lay one complete L3 across the chosen line coverage, with recorded-device tone; do not repeat or split it. Use one complete live-feed L5 across c11/c12, without an invented response.
Incoming-tone coverage c09/c10 represents one contact. The telephone device and any connection gesture remain offscreen; no additional action is implied.

Match c14, c15 and c16 on the same 1–3 second wrist glance and 3–5 second steering movement. Choose a cut through the action rather than repeating the turn. Check wheel position, hand grip, wet-light direction and road movement at joins.

Dinu's unspecified work shirt is fixed as plain charcoal, and the unspecified thread-bearing wrist is fixed as his left. Both hands stay on the wheel; the photograph remains left of the instrument cluster.

The photograph is a faded printed object with indistinct figures, not a live appearance or a flashback. Avoid mirrors, intricate finger work, physically interacting bodies and sharply rendered crowds.
Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options from clean sources; none is prescribed for this restrained scene. Do not add slow motion, music or a chase treatment.

editor_notes: The 92-second bin is raw source, not a locked 92-second edit. Use the driving masters for geography, singles for interior attention, the required photograph detail to register the keepsake, and reactions for landing space.

Although c13 was generated after the line angles, place its b2 playback onset before c06 or c07 for b3. Lay one complete L3 across the chosen line coverage, with recorded-device tone; do not repeat or split it. Use one complete live-feed L5 across c11/c12, without an invented response.
Incoming-tone coverage c09/c10 represents one contact. The telephone device and any connection gesture remain offscreen; no additional action is implied.

Match c14, c15 and c16 on the same 1–3 second wrist glance and 3–5 second steering movement. Choose a cut through the action rather than repeating the turn. Check wheel position, hand grip, wet-light direction and road movement at joins.

Dinu's unspecified work shirt is fixed as plain charcoal, and the unspecified thread-bearing wrist is fixed as his left. Both hands stay on the wheel; the photograph remains left of the instrument cluster.

The photograph is a faded printed object with indistinct figures, not a live appearance or a flashback. Avoid mirrors, intricate finger work, physically interacting bodies and sharply rendered crowds.
Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options from clean sources; none is prescribed for this restrained scene. Do not add slow motion, music or a chase treatment.
blend_notes: c17: Cut into c14 or c16 between the downward glance and the eyes returning to the road, then return to the selected action; carry that anchor's engine and rain audio.
c18: Close moment 6 after the completed turn in c15, without repeating the turn; carry c15's engine and rain audio.
c19: Lay the held wheel-framed reaction over the single selected L5 audio from c11 or c12, with its matching cab ambience.
c20: Lay the eyes detail over the single selected L3 audio from c06 or c07; retain the selected anchor's cab ambience and use c08 for the wider aftermath as needed.
c21: Open moment 1 before c01, carrying rain and engine ambience into the master; no dialogue.

review.why: A rain-on-windscreen opening gives the contained journey a tactile visual texture before the driving master.
The locked photograph insert and contextual master already cover the keepsake and its position; another detail would repeat them.
An isolated eyes reaction lets the personal message register while preserving the existing wider reaction for its aftermath.
The locked master and attention reaction establish the interruption; an invented handset or additional neutral coverage would add nothing.
A wheel-framed reaction gives the instruction a restrained landing while keeping Dinu's driving present.
A red-thread insert clarifies the glance, and a roadward interior POV lets the changed heading carry the ending without repeating the turn.
